pages.title: Seafood Boil
pages.text: One pot, four bowls, and the only meal out here that warms you back up.$(br2)Eat it while it steams.
Any three of cod, salmon, $(l:getting_started/ice_fishing)Glassblood or Rime Hagfish$(/l). The bucket comes back.

pages.title: Cooking
pages.text: Cook it in a furnace, smoker or campfire.

pages.title: Steam
pages.text: A fresh pot holds its heat until you pick it up. Then it $(bold)steams for 5 minutes$().$(br2)Place it and take $(bold)four servings$() with empty bowls. Each bowl keeps the pot's remaining steam.$(br2)A $(l:heating/thermal_container)Thermal Container$(/l) pauses the countdown. Steaming food does not frost.
Eaten while Steaming: $(bold)Warm Meal$(), +15°C body temperature for 3 minutes.$(br2)Cold, it is still a full meal.$(br2)Breaking a started pot spills the rest.
